The trn22 c5c r1 attempt stopped during compile before step 0 and has no score, so it cannot fill the trn21 control gap. The trn22 r2 package supplies the identical science contract while every trn21 host fact remains separately gated.
trainium_feasibility: Pinned c5c source; full-chip LNC2/world4; seed 42, max_train_seconds 1800 and optlevel-1 BF16 compiler flags explicitly bound in a future clean effective environment. The historical trn21 35c9 full run used 1,846,603,776 root bytes from preflight to postflight, but this does not bound a future c5c compile. The provisional pre-dispatch free-space gate is 10 GiB, equal to the pending trn22 r2 threshold, with continuous monitoring above the unchanged 6.5-GiB floor. Human EBS expansion, trn21 G1, exact-env G2, live warm-cache authentication and independent review remain prerequisites.
